name: Quooker
verdict: Quooker is a private Dutch family business owned by Niels and Walter Peteri. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Family-owned boiling-water-tap maker from Ridderkerk. Feyenoord partner to mid-2029; in 2025-26 its logo appeared on the sleeve for KNVB Beker and European matches only (not on the Eredivisie home shirt, where the sleeve belongs to Eurojackpot).
